issue_request: FHIR-35931 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R FHIR-core issue proposing that Ingredient.substance.strength.referenceStrength.substance be 1..1 while not making referenceStrength itself mandatory.

additional_context: FHIR-35931 follows the FHIR-31819/FHIR-31820 referenceStrength documentation family and supports the same conclusion that a reference strength must identify its reference substance. The current source still leaves referenceStrength itself optional at 0..*.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source has referenceStrength.substance min=1/max=1 and Ingredient is the active build-scope location.
